impl-location-check.desc: Verifies that all impls: - Live in a `t` commons module (see import-rules check); and - Are in the same file or a sibling file of the type's definition.
impl-location-check.rationale: This is one check in part of an effort to keep impls small and prefer functions (which would live outside of `t` commons modules) over methods.

exceptions.exception: For foreign types (i.e. not defined in our crate; like: `impl SomeTrait for Vec<T>`), the impl must live in an `ext_traits` commons module (see import-rules check).
For private types, an impl lives in the same file as the type definition, which can be anywhere in the codebase.
